war_summary: War 139 is on day 116 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated in rear areas — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many others; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the prior snapshot (~3h ago), Olavis Wake has gone quiet after its Ilmari Bridge fight resolved for the Colonials. Endless Shore is the largest battle: 7-3 Colonial now, ~48 events/24h with the latest event minutes before cutoff, though casualty rates have cooled from their peak (~300-350/hr). Oarbreaker remains extremely active (46 events/24h, latest event at cutoff) with heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge and Integrum; Wardens hold 9-0 but the fight continues. Clahstra is sharply escalating — casualty rates have roughly tripled (~650-875/hr per side) with fresh events around Transept, East Narthex and Weephome, currently 6-2 Warden. Marban Hollow continues surging (~260-290/hr per side, events at Sanctum within hours, 5-3 Warden). Godcrofts stays a knife-fight (31 events/24h at Saegio/Argosa, latest event <1h old, 4-4-1 split). Speaking Woods shows very high casualty rates (~440-600/hr) but no events in ~9h; Callahan's Passage shows massive sustained attrition (~9k-11k casualties/24h) but no events in ~12h. Quiet rear hexes remain static.
